title: Pairdrop (LinuxServer.io)
description: Pairdrop is a sublime alternative to Airdrop that works on all platforms. Send images, documents or text via peer to peer connection to devices in the same local network/Wi-Fi or to paired devices.
tagline: A sublime alternative to Airdrop that works on all platforms. Send images, documents or text via peer to peer connection to devices in the same local network/Wi-Fi or to paired devices.
